$comment: ADR-0038. Every object whose keys the chart defines refuses unknown keys, so a misspelt key fails helm install, upgrade, template and lint with a message naming it. Maps whose keys you choose stay open. A key with no type is checked by the templates, whose message is more precise. values.yaml explains every key.
title: harbor-workload-identity-bridge values

global.description: Values Helm shares with subcharts, set by umbrella charts. This chart reads none of them.

clusterName.description: Required. Name of this cluster and prefix of its Harbor robot names: a DNS label without consecutive hyphens, distinct for every cluster that shares the Harbor.

harbor.description: The Harbor instance the bridge manages robots in.

url.description: Required. Base URL of Harbor, https and without a user:password@ part.

allowInsecureHTTP.description: Allow an http:// harbor.url anyway, e.g. for an in-cluster Harbor in a test cluster.

caSecret.description: Existing Secret in the release namespace with the CA that signs Harbor's certificate.

name.description: Name of the Secret. Empty uses the system trust store.

key.description: Key of the CA certificate in the Secret.

adminCredsSecret.description: Existing Secret in the release namespace with the Harbor admin credentials. The chart does not create it.

username.description: Key that holds the user name.

robotNamePrefix.description: Harbor's robot_name_prefix setting. Change it only if the Harbor administrator changed that setting.

tls.description: The bridge's serving certificate. The bridge always serves TLS and the plugin always verifies it.

enabled.description: true: cert-manager issues the certificate (tls.issuerRef). false: you provide it in tls.existingSecret.

existingSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with tls.crt, tls.key and ca.crt. Required when tls.enabled is false.

issuerRef.description: cert-manager issuer that signs the serving certificate.

name.description: Name of the issuer. Required when tls.enabled is true.

kind.description: Kind of the issuer, ClusterIssuer or Issuer.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name in labels.

fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the release name in object names.

bridge.description: The bridge Deployment: the controller and the credential endpoint.

replicas.description: Number of bridge replicas. Leader election is on when it is above 1.

leaderElection.description: true or false to force leader election, unset for on when bridge.replicas > 1. false with more than one replica is refused.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty uses the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: Pin the image by digest (sha256:...). When set, tag is ignored.

oidcIssuer.description: Issuer of the ServiceAccount tokens the bridge validates. It must match the cluster's issuer.

oidcJWKSURL.description: Where the bridge fetches the token signing keys. Empty uses OIDC discovery at bridge.oidcIssuer.

oidcCAFile.description: CA bundle that verifies the TLS certificate of the OIDC issuer.

oidcTokenFile.description: The bridge's own ServiceAccount token, sent on discovery and JWKS requests to the in-cluster apiserver. Empty disables it.

forceLocalValidation.description: Reserved for native OIDC trust policies in Harbor. Keep true.

tokenValidation.description: Which ServiceAccount tokens the credential endpoint accepts (ADR-0028).

maxLifetime.description: Longest lifetime (exp - iat) of an accepted token, a Go duration such as 1h.

requirePodBinding.description: Refuse tokens without the kubernetes.io pod claim. false weakens the bridge.

logLevel.description: Log level: debug, info, warn or error.

harborAccessSelector.description: Labels a HarborAccess must carry for this bridge to serve it (ADR-0026). Empty serves every HarborAccess. Values must be strings.

instance.description: Names this bridge among several, in its finalizer harbor.aetherize.io/robot-<instance>. Empty uses the release name.

rateLimit.description: Limit of the credential endpoint per source IP.

perSource.description: Requests per second from one source IP. 0 disables the limit.

burst.description: Burst of requests from one source IP, a positive whole number.

mTLS.description: mTLS between plugin and bridge, on top of the token validation (ADR-0008).

enabled.description: Require a client certificate from the plugin.

clientIssuerRef.description: cert-manager CA issuer that signs the plugin's client certificates. Its CA must be the ca.crt of the bridge's TLS Secret.

name.description: Name of the issuer. Required when bridge.mTLS.enabled is true.

kind.description: Kind of the issuer, ClusterIssuer or Issuer.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the bridge container.

podDisruptionBudget.description: Keeps a bridge replica serving through voluntary disruptions. Rendered only when bridge.replicas > 1.

maxUnavailable.description: Bridge pods that may be unavailable at once, a number or a percentage.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations of the bridge pods.

podLabels.description: Extra labels of the bridge pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the bridge pods. Keys you add are merged with kubernetes.io/os: linux; drop that one with kubernetes.io/os: null.

affinity.description: Extra affinity of the bridge pods, next to the chart's soft pod anti-affinity.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables of the bridge container, as Kubernetes EnvVar objects.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources of the bridge container.

plugin.description: The kubelet credential-provider plugin and the DaemonSet that installs it on every node.

enabled.description: Deploy the node installer DaemonSet. false when the nodes get the plugin by other means (docs/install-external-plugin.md).

namespace.description: Namespace of the plugin DaemonSet and its objects (ADR-0027). Empty uses the release namespace.

createNamespace.description: Create plugin.namespace. false means the namespace must exist.

caBundle.description: With plugin.namespace only: where trust-manager gets the CA that signs the bridge's serving certificate.

source.description: Exactly one of secret or configMap, in trust-manager's trust namespace.

key.description: Key of the CA in the Secret.
Key of the CA in the ConfigMap.

matchImages.description: Required when plugin.enabled is true. Images for which kubelet calls the plugin, as host[:port][/path] with globs only in the host.

audience.description: Required. Audience of the ServiceAccount token kubelet sends. It must match spec.trustPolicy.audience of every HarborAccess.

audienceRBAC.description: RBAC that lets every kubelet request tokens for plugin.audience (ADR-0017).

create.description: Create the ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding. Disable only if you provide your own RBAC.

image.description: The plugin image, which also carries the node installer.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty uses the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: Pin the image by digest (sha256:...); kubelet runs this binary as root on every node. When set, tag is ignored.

providerName.description: Name of the kubelet provider entry and the plugin binary, a DNS label as a string. Change it only to run several installs per cluster (ADR-0029).

hostBinaryDir.description: Node directory of the plugin binary in patch and none mode.

hostConfigDir.description: Node directory of the bridge CA and the mTLS client pair, and of the provider config in patch and none mode.

install.description: How the installer wires the plugin into kubelet (ADR-0021).

binDir.description: Merge mode only: kubelet's credential-provider bin dir. Empty uses the one kubelet's flags name.

configFile.description: Merge mode only: kubelet's credential-provider config file. Empty uses the one kubelet's flags name.

stateDir.description: Node directory of the installer's state file. Not plugin.hostConfigDir or a directory inside it.

action.description: install wires the plugin into kubelet on every node; remove takes this install's entry and files off every node again (ADR-0039).

uninstall.description: What helm uninstall does on the nodes: a pre-delete hook Job that has every node remove this install's entry and files (ADR-0039).

enabled.description: Render the pre-delete hook; false leaves the nodes as they are at helm uninstall.

maxUnavailable.description: Nodes that remove at once: a number, or a percentage of the nodes rounded up, plus the nodes whose plugin pod is down already.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the hook waits for every node, in seconds; keep it below helm uninstall --timeout.

bridgeEndpoint.description: URL the plugin calls the bridge at. Empty uses https://127.0.0.1:<service.nodePort>; the installer replaces a literal $(NODE_IP).

allowSelfMatchImages.description: Allow plugin.matchImages to name the registry of the chart's own images (air-gapped mirrors).

defaultCacheDuration.description: Required field of the kubelet provider entry, unused while the plugin answers. A Go duration such as 1h.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the installer containers.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations of the plugin pods.

podLabels.description: Extra labels of the plugin pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the plugin pods. Keys you add are merged with kubernetes.io/os: linux; drop that one with kubernetes.io/os: null.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the plugin pods. The default tolerates every taint, so kubelet on every node gets the plugin.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass of the plugin pods, as a string. "" leaves the field out.

patchKubelet.description: Removed (ADR-0021). The chart refuses it with a message; use plugin.install.mode instead.

type.description: Service type. The plugin's default endpoint needs NodePort or LoadBalancer.

port.description: Service port of the credential endpoint.

nodePort.description: Node port the plugin's default endpoint calls. null lets the apiserver pick one, which needs plugin.bridgeEndpoint.

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics, plain HTTP on the pod network only.

enabled.description: Serve /metrics and render the metrics Service.

serviceMonitor.description: A Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the metrics Service.
